name: Tanker Truck
summary: Ink sketch cab pulling a long cylindrical tank trailer, in side view facing right; for fuel.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 850 px wide and 400 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.85 for a smaller scene

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the body bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the cab faces left

author: krakujs
